plugins.name: prompt-forge
plugins.description: Spend Claude Code tokens where they count: moves a new task into a fresh session (a new terminal, or a new Superset workspace for unrelated work) instead of dragging a long conversation along, and runs small, clear tasks on Sonnet. -41% per session in its benchmark; your prompts go out as typed.
